children: IEH entered into a new employment agreement with CFO, Treasurer and Corporate Secretary Subrata Purkayastha, effective November 1, 2026.
Chief Financial Officer, Treasurer and Corporate Secretary

Annual base salary of $293,950; eligible for an annual bonus of up to 100% of base salary and equity awards. Receives 35,000 immediately vested options at a $29.60 exercise price. Qualifying termination entitles her to 24 months of base salary and up to 24 months of health and welfare plan participation.
